parameters.name: BurstingEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the I/O Burst feature for the ESSD AutoPL disk. Valid value:

*   **true**
*   **false** (default)

>  This parameter is available only when the StorageType parameter is set to ESSDAUTOPL.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb modify-db-cluster-storage-performance --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000 --client-token 6000170000591aed949d0f000000000000000000 --provisioned-iops 2500 --storage-type ESSDAUTOPL --bursting-enabled false --modify-type Upgrade --auto-use-coupon true --promotion-code 727xxxxxx934 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb ModifyDBClusterStoragePerformance --region cn-hangzhou --BurstingEnabled false --ModifyType Upgrade --StorageType ESSDAUTOPL --AutoUseCoupon true --PromotionCode 727xxxxxx934 --DBClusterId 'pc-0000000000000' --ClientToken 6000170000591aed949d0f000000000000000000 --ProvisionedIops 2500
